realizes.rationale: Renders all three zoom levels (defaulting Level 1 to 'first-principles' with numeric ?level=1/2/3 and legacy 'abitur' aliases) stacked in static/script-off/print HTML, upgrades to WAI-ARIA roving-tabindex tabs, switches hidden panels and scrolls on nextTick+double-rAF for initial load, hashchange, popstate and VitePress On-this-page outline clicks, preserves non-level heading hashes via replaceState and cleans up listeners on unmount.

1.note:
Defines the three zoom tabs (`first-principles`/`undergrad`/`lean` mapped to `level1`/`level2`/`level3` slots with default `activeLevel = 'first-principles'`), `LEVEL_ALIAS_HASHES`, `pageId` prop, `rootRef` and pre-hydration `hydrated = false` state.

Anchor: `TABS`; `LEVEL_ALIAS_HASHES`

2.note:
Parses `?level=` (`1`/`2`/`3`, named and legacy `abitur`) and heading/alias hashes (`parseQueryLevel`, `resolveHashTarget`), switches panels and scrolls via `nextTick` + double-`rAF` (`scheduleScroll`), syncs `?level=` via `history.replaceState` preserving non-level heading hashes (`syncUrl`), handles `hashchange`, `popstate`, VitePress `On this page` outline clicks (`onDocumentClick`) and roving-tabindex keyboard navigation (`onTabKeydown`), and cleans up timers/rAFs/listeners in `onBeforeUnmount`.

Anchor: `parseQueryLevel`; `onDocumentClick`; `onTabKeydown`

3.note:
Progressively enhances from script-off static jump nav and stacked panels to WAI-ARIA `tablist`/`tabpanel` controls bound to `rootRef` with roving `tabindex` and print-restorable headings.

Anchor: `rh-zoom-tablist`
